# Evidence limits and remaining release work

The implementation is an active eight-domain upgrade. It is not yet the complete
Pilot/Core benchmark release and has not established agent improvement.

## What the current evidence establishes

All eight world generators are executable and registered separately from
historical distributions. Four new domains have genuine native models, independent
Reference and actual mutations, scoped tools, frozen Customer information,
external simulators, task certificates and Replay. Current tests exercise real
business rules and illegal Sandbox mutations; scripted model responses are only
the transport fixture. The education checkpoint completed 1153 repository tests.
The four dialogue domains have 100 invariant-valid audited worlds each and
source-complete reproducible examples. Versioned state censuses separate future
outcomes from current business states.

These checks demonstrate implementation properties at their recorded source
versions. They do not validate the representativeness of contracts, service
quality, learned Skill effectiveness or practical human workflows.

## Mandatory work still open

- Expand meaningful initial case/lifecycle histories and cross-entity tasks in
  the new domains. Current opening consumption and background calendars are not
  a complete historical-case distribution.
- Audit task-level Reference boundaries and meaningful causal/alternative paths;
  world-structure counts are insufficient.
- Build the balanced 320-task Pilot and 800-task Core with certified strata and
  honest shortfall reports. They do not exist merely because generators can
  produce hundreds of hashes.
- Complete all-domain semantic/task/world split isolation and true private
  Held-out generation. The basic structure-partition helper alone is insufficient.
- Bind all native task/trace variants to unified evaluation and eight-domain
  Frozen Discovery, source-bound bidirectional search, fixed Customer,
  Reflection, StaticSkillGate, inheritance and exact selection Replay.
- Finish release manifests, actual coverage matrices, fairness/ablation validation
  and final full-scope verification.

## Research cautions

Anonymous colour-refinement signatures are conservative grouping heuristics, not
full graph-isomorphism proofs. Excluding names, IDs and raw numeric jitter reduces
obvious inflation; no signature definition alone proves meaningful task novelty.
A bounded successful path is a witness, not automatically the shortest necessary
path; bounded failure is not an impossibility proof.

A changed native decision under a verified counterfactual establishes the stated
interaction dependency, not natural-language quality or a requirement for a fixed
number of turns. All six dependency kinds can be represented; that does not mean
every published task covers all six, or that all domain/capability cells are full.

Equal-weight aggregation is implemented independently of candidate selection.
It cannot certify the truth of arbitrary input metrics; native trace validators
remain necessary. Descriptors and coverage annotations require independent proof.
No actual real-model comparison, Designer learning gain, Service improvement,
cross-domain generalization or expert review has been performed (`NOT RUN`).
